Rigging: Can assist with rigging the boat
Launching & Recovery: Can launch a dinghy and get under way with instruction
Can secure a boat to a trolley
Can assist with recovery and stowage of dinghy and gear
Ropework: Can tie a figure of eight knot and cleat a halyard
Sailing Techniques & Manoeuvres: Can be a responsive crew under instruction
Can steer when sailing and being towed
Can steer on a reach and go about
Understands the effect of basic boat controls
Understands the basic principles of stopping, controlling speed and getting out of irons
Clothing & Equipment: Can put on personal buoyancy correctly
Is confident in the water wearing personal buoyancy
Capsize Recovery: Understands the importance of staying with the boat

General: Can name basic parts of the boat
Understands what action to take to assist those needing help
Understands how to prepare for a tow
Clothing & Equipment: Understands personal safety - and knows what to wear for sailing
